lines.t:
A <c:ffff00>sub-skill<c> for <c:ffff00>melee<c> attacks that deals <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c> to
<c:ffff00>{{all_parts}}<c> with a powerful impact.
With any <c:ffff00>action<c>, it applies the <c:ffff00>{{damage_trait}}<c> of all
parts, and since the whole body's momentum goes
into the <c:ffff00>attack<c>, the <c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c> of the <c:ffff00>legs<c> is added to
<c:ffff00>{{power}}<c>.
The violent movement leaves it wide open after
attacking: during the <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> of a Berserk <c:ffff00>act<c>, it is
<c:ffff00>unable to defend<c> and <c:ffff00>unable to evade<c>.
